scope: Additive TB-CHI official-gamebook correction. Preserves the earlier receipt blob and its truthful HTTP 404 observation, then records the stable official gamebook transition to HTTP 200 application/pdf. Corrects the premature interim 16-24 score to the terminal official TB 24-CHI 27 final, completes both teams' starters/substitutes/DNP/not-active, literal gamebook injury/return, quarterback-duty and specialist-duty inventories, and retains absent phase snap counts, distinct replacement allocation, player-value provenance and Luther Burden terminal status as explicit unresolved inputs. No started-game prediction, fair, carried rating, market field or numerical injury loss is changed.
estimationPolicy: Factual source correction only. Complete gamebook participation identities do not supply phase snap exposure, distinct relief allocation or player/replacement values. Missing values are not zero and no new numerical method is authorized.
